front-line.why: Lightning Step at 10 unblocks the congested bonus action, and the lightning scales off Constitution, already this body's armour stat.

durability.why: The subclass grants its own heavy armour and flat reduction at three, so level one is free for Warlock's Wisdom and Charisma saves.

uncertain: Nothing can heal this body, which vetoes a healer partner and rules out the Bloodhunter variant's self-damaging rite.

action-economy.why: Fast Hands plus Lone Wolf is a third bonus action, and Beast Master's companion at Ranger 3 adds a whole third body.

front-line.why: Alacrity, Action Surge and Lone Wolf give four opening Actions against creatures that have not acted yet.

uncertain: Contributes little once the first round is over; scores as burst, not as a body.

action-economy.why: Quickened and Twinned Haste hand an Action to both bodies, and Cunning Action still leaves a bonus action spare.

skills.why: Reliable Talent at Rogue 11 under four Expertise picks, plus Bard 6's pair and Jack of All Trades, clears every gate.

front-line.why: Rakish Audacity needs no second melee body, and Paladin 3 turns Cleric 6's slots into Divine Smite on the Sneak Attack.
Insightful Fighting enables Sneak Attack with no ally in reach, and Crimson Rite rides every hit on no clock at all.

action-economy.why: Bonus-action Help hands the partner advantage every round without spending an Action, and Rogue 14 keeps the subclass's own tier-three feature.

front-line.why: Rage's physical resistance lets a Phantom stand in melee, where Wails from the Grave splits each Sneak Attack onto a second target.
Ambush Master and Dread Ambusher stack on Listo's d10 initiative, and the first-round mark hands the partner advantage too.

uncertain: Lands on the same opening-round body as Assassin; if only one survives, Assassin bursts harder.
Psychic is commonly resisted under Absolute Wrath, which caps the blade's single-target ceiling.

short-rest.why: Psionic dice, Warlock pact slots and Font of Inspiration are three pools that all refill on the short rest.

reaction.why: Auspicious Parry and Spell Siphon spend the reactions Lone Wolf doubled, and Wizard 6 adds Shield and Counterspell on the same Intelligence.

action-economy.split: Ranger 17 (Beast Master) / Druid 3 (Circle of the Land)
action-economy.why: Companion scales off proficiency and Helps as a bonus action, Wild Companion adds a familiar, and both halves run on Wisdom.

front-line.why: Dread Ambusher and Assassin's restored Action delete one enemy before it acts, and Iron Mind patches the missing Wisdom save.
Volley at 11 is the class's only real AoE, and Action Surge fires it twice in the round that has to clear adds.

lockdown.why: Moths blind once per round off your own attack at no concentration cost; Reckless Attack and Haste buy more attacks to blind from.

action-economy.why: Infused Strikes adds a die to the partner's attacks too, and Reflexive Resistance is a second life-saving reaction Lone Wolf makes affordable.

skills.why: Wisdom added to every Charisma check, plus Lore's Expertise and three proficiencies, makes one character the face with no Charisma spent.

front-line.why: Planar Warrior converts the hit to Force, deleting Absolute Wrath's resistances, and Thief's second bonus action pays for it beside Hunter's Mark.

front-line.split: Ranger 17 (Monster Slayer) / Bloodhunter 3 (Order of the Ghostslayer)
front-line.why: Slayer's Prey costs no concentration, so it stacks with Hunter's Mark and Crimson Rite; Magic-User's Nemesis is a free counterspell.

durability.why: Guardian Aura heals a hurt partner every turn for no action; Cleric 6 keeps everything on Wisdom and adds short-rest Channel Divinity.

lockdown.why: Divine Smite is Radiant, so every smite trips Glaring Frost's blind; a radiant domain doubles the sources on a short-rest clock.

reaction.split: Ranger 15 (Snowlight Conclave) / Monk 3 (Way of the Friar) / Cleric 2 (Light)
reaction.why: Friar's Retribution converts every incoming hit into Radiant, which Glaring Frost turns into a blind save and Anthelion spreads to the cluster.

front-line.why: Divine Flurry's extra attacks at 11 all fire with Reckless Attack's advantage into a reduced crit threshold; Haste adds an Action.

uncertain: The Reckless Attack synergy assumes Divine Flurry's attacks are melee; if the Valkyrie form is ranged the sweep's Fighter 3 is better.

action-economy.why: Red Banner hands the partner a reaction attack on the short-rest clock from Paragon 6; Wizard 6 adds Haste and smite fuel.

uncertain: Whether banner charges scale with Paragon level past 6 is unverified; if they do, the sweep's Paragon 17 is the better body.

front-line.why: Stripping resistances, blocking healing and treating the target as sunlit makes the partner's damage type stop mattering; Bird Cage punishes disengaging.

durability.why: Flat damage reduction is worth double under Lone Wolf's halving, and Competitive Streak refunds Willpower dice off the partner's crits.

front-line.why: Shifting Court swaps the armoured body into the pack and pulls the partner out, and Thief's second bonus action pays for it.

uncertain: Regent earns its keep by repositioning rather than damage; front-line is the closest niche, not an exact one.

front-line.why: Same Charisma attack stat, different clock: short-rest pact slots and Divine Smite turn every hit into burst the capstone body cannot match.

short-rest.why: Scholar's Armament makes Charisma the attack stat, so Paragon Of Legend's +4 past the 20 cap lands entirely on one stat.

front-line.why: Falling Rain is a free-action attack on every Willpower Die spent, and Beyond All Limits at 18 refills the pool each turn.

inquisitor/Tactics Inquisition.why: The subclass lands at level 3, where the shipped install has a dangling subclass GUID; the mod needs updating to 2.2.1.

inquisitor/Vengeance Inquisition.why: Unreachable: Inquisitor is unusable past level 2 on the shipped install because of the dangling level-3 subclass GUID; needs the mod updated to 2.2.1.

inquisitor/Zeal Inquisition.why: Every feature sits at Inquisitor 3 or later, and the shipped install breaks at level 3 on a dangling GUID; needs updating to 2.2.1.
